title: Separeco
content: Separeco is an Italian engineering company that supplies supercritical CO2 equipment and dedicated systems for aerogel drying. Its official aerogel solution pages describe supercritical drying as a key step in aerogel production and position autoclave-based CO2 systems as a preferred approach for drying wet gels while reducing thermal stress and supporting solvent recovery. Separeco is a strong fit for teams evaluating process equipment for aerogel scale-up and production.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
